description:
## What is a Cluster?

A **Cluster** is the regional grouping that sits between Head Office and your individual Branches. A Cluster Director owns the cluster's branches and runs them as a group.

Every Branch must belong to a Cluster — even single-region operators usually start with one Cluster (e.g. `CLR-NORTH`) and add more as the network grows.

Give your first Cluster a short **code** (e.g. `CLR-NORTH`) and a friendly **name** (e.g. `Northern Punjab Cluster`).
